slots.notes: Fullscreen mouse-scrubbed background video (absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover). It does NOT autoplay or loop: it loads paused at currentTime 0, and horizontal mouse movement scrubs forward/backward through its timeline (delta * SENSITIVITY 0.8 * duration, seek-chained on the 'seeked' event). Needs full per-frame seekability and a fairly long shot so the scrub has range; no color overlay sits on top so the footage carries the entire backdrop behind the nav and headline.

Display face for the oversized uppercase H1 (Tailwind font-grotesk). Native value is the Google Font 'Anton' (a tall condensed sans, ~400). The headline ramps text-[40px] -> sm:60px -> md:75px -> lg:90px at near-solid leading (1.05 -> 1.0), so a substitute must tolerate Anton's narrow, all-caps, tight-leading metric or the three-line block will rewrap.

Cursive script face for the floating 'Nft collection' accent span (Tailwind font-condiment). Native value is the Google Font 'Condiment' (cursive). It is absolutely positioned over the top-right of the heading, rotated -1deg, opacity-90, tinted neon #6FFF00 with mixBlendMode 'exclusion', so the swap must be a script/handwritten face whose glyph baseline survives the blend and overlap.

Inline geometric brand mark in the navbar left slot: a 28x28 SVG, viewBox 0 0 256 256, a single custom <path> filled solid #111111 (near-black). Supply as a transparent-background single-color glyph squared to the 256 viewBox; the fill hex is baked into the markup, so retinting means editing the SVG.

Mobile hamburger toggle icon pair (open + close), the lucide-react 'Menu' and 'X' glyphs at size 22, colored text-gray-900 (near-black). Only rendered below md; swap as a 2-state line-icon pair (open / close) matching the same stroke weight.

mechanic: A full-screen object-cover background video is scrubbed frame-by-frame by horizontal mouse position (seek-chained on the 'seeked' event, no autoplay) while a bottom-left oversized uppercase Anton headline carries a floating exclusion-blended neon Condiment script accent, beneath a fixed top nav of an inline-SVG logo, a centered dark glassy pill menu, and a green-dot CTA pill.
techDelivery: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS 3 (PostCSS/Autoprefixer) component spec; native <video> driven by a mousemove/seeked scrub handler holding mutable state in useRefs (targetTime / isSeeking / prevX), Google Fonts (Anton + Condiment) loaded via <link> in index.html, lucide-react for the Menu/X icons.
reskinNotes: The scrub interaction is the whole identity and is metric-sensitive: SENSITIVITY 0.8 and the 0.01s seek-chain threshold are tuned to a long, fully-seekable clip, so a short or sparsely-keyframed brand video will feel jumpy or unresponsive, and since nothing overlays the footage a light/busy video will wash out the white headline and dark nav. The headline is three hardcoded lines with literal spaced parentheses ('( ' its ' )') and a near-solid leading/letter ramp tuned to Anton all-caps, so longer copy or a wider substitute font rewraps the block; the neon accent depends on mixBlendMode 'exclusion' against the video, which renders differently per brand color/footage. The logo is an inline <path> with #111111 baked as the fill, the nav uses raw Tailwind grays (gray-900 pills, gray-300 labels, green-400 dot) rather than the themed tokens, and all nav labels / CTA text / site name are hardcoded in markup; an unused .liquid-glass utility (rgba border via mask-composite exclude) ships in index.css as part of the design system.
